title: Immutable reproduction identity for a run record
description: The identity block assembled by clozn.runs.identity.runtime_identity(). Every field except captured_at is OPTIONAL by design: clozn omits a key it cannot honestly measure rather than null-padding it, so absence stays visible and is never mistaken for a measured value. Extensions contributed by clozn.runs.identity_ext providers land under `ext`, namespaced by provider, so features can add identity facets without editing this schema.

captured_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this identity block was assembled.

model_path.description: Absolute path to the model file as resolved at run time.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact model bytes. Preferred source is the engine's own /health field, computed once at boot.

template_fingerprint.description: First 16 hex chars of the SHA-256 of CANONICAL_CONVERSATION rendered through the run's chat template. Fingerprints template AND tokenizer rendering behavior together.

engine_build.description: Build identifier for the clozn-server binary. Absent on engine builds whose /health does not report one -- absence means 'not reported', never 'unbuilt'.

ext.description: Namespaced identity facets contributed by clozn.runs.identity_ext providers. Each key is a provider name (e.g. 'engine_artifact', 'adapter', 'machine'); each value is that provider's own object. A reader that does not recognise a namespace must preserve it, not drop it.
